title: Shared atoms of the router-api contract
description: Referenced by the other router-api schemas; validates nothing on its own. Identifiers, versions, amounts, timestamps, nodes and denominations are the provider-role contract's, by reference.

endpoint.description: A node and an asset, with the unit the asset is counted in there: one whole asset is 10^decimals units (REQ-CAT-11). The node is an inner node by identifier, or an outer node by its network (REQ-CAT-17).

ratio.description: A rational number, numerator / denominator, in whole numbers so that no figure is rounded on the way in.
